summary.de: Großes Becken östlich des befestigten Stadtkerns, oben rund 73 Meter lang und 29 Meter breit. Mehrere Treppen führen hinunter.
summary.en: Large basin east of the fortified core, about 73 metres long and 29 metres wide at the top. Several flights of steps descend into it.
